from pathlib import Path
import os, subprocess, time, json, statistics, hashlib, platform

out = Path(__file__).resolve().parent
cache = Path(os.environ['TEMP']) / 'lme-toolchain-20261010' / 'sccache-v0.16.0-x86_64-pc-windows-msvc' / 'sccache.exe'
source = next((Path.home() / '.cargo/registry/src').glob('*/smallvec-1.15.1/src/lib.rs'))
probe = out / 'compiler-probe'
probe.mkdir(exist_ok=True)
env = os.environ.copy()
env.update(SCCACHE_DIR=str(out / 'compiler-cache'), SCCACHE_SERVER_PORT='43241', CARGO_INCREMENTAL='0', CARGO_TERM_COLOR='never')
compiler = subprocess.check_output(['rustup', 'which', 'rustc'], text=True).strip()
cmd = [compiler, '--edition=2018', '--crate-name', 'smallvec', '--crate-type', 'rlib', '--emit=link', '-O', '--out-dir', str(probe), str(source)]
subprocess.run([str(cache), '--zero-stats'], env=env, check=True, capture_output=True)
rows = []

def run(cached, index, warmup):
    full = ([str(cache)] if cached else []) + cmd
    t = time.perf_counter()
    result = subprocess.run(full, env=env, capture_output=True, text=True)
    elapsed = time.perf_counter() - t
    if result.returncode:
        raise RuntimeError(result.stderr)
    rows.append(dict(cached=cached, index=index, warmup=warmup, elapsed_seconds=elapsed, exit_code=result.returncode))

for i in range(2):
    run(False, i, True)
    run(True, i, True)
for i in range(10):
    for cached in ([False, True] if i % 2 == 0 else [True, False]):
        run(cached, i, False)
stats = subprocess.check_output([str(cache), '--show-stats', '--stats-format', 'json'], env=env, text=True)
subprocess.run([str(cache), '--stop-server'], env=env, check=True, capture_output=True)
report = dict(base_revision=subprocess.check_output(['git', 'rev-parse', 'HEAD'], text=True).strip(), scope='Warm compiler-cache mechanism test on smallvec 1.15.1, a repository dependency. Not complete Cargo build or hosted-CI timing.', rustc=subprocess.check_output([compiler, '-Vv'], text=True), sccache=subprocess.check_output([str(cache), '--version'], text=True).strip(), platform=platform.platform(), source=str(source), source_sha256=hashlib.sha256(source.read_bytes()).hexdigest(), command=cmd, warmups_per_variant=2, samples_per_variant=10, samples=rows, sccache_stats=json.loads(stats), medians_seconds={str(c): statistics.median(r['elapsed_seconds'] for r in rows if r['cached']==c and not r['warmup']) for c in [False, True]})
(out / 'compiler-cache.json').write_text(json.dumps(report, indent=2) + '\n')
print(json.dumps(report['medians_seconds']))
print(stats)
